All datasets in the VIEWS API are labeled in accordance with the [VIEWS dataset naming convention](https://github.com/prio-data/views_api/wiki/Dataset-naming-conventions), which in turn references the [VIEWS model(s)](https://github.com/prio-data/views_api/wiki/VIEWS-model-library) from which a given set of predictions were generated. 

For more information about the models currently in use, please visit our [website](https://viewsforecasting.org) and consult the [model changelog](https://github.com/prio-data/viewsforecasting/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

# Input data/predictor datasets

| Dataset                              | Related model     | Related model version  | Start date  | End date | Update schedule | First released | Codebook |
| ----------------------------------   | ----------------- | ---------------------- | ----------- | -------- | -------------- | ------- |  -------- |
| predictors_fatalities003_0000_00     | fatalities        | 003                    | 1990-01     | Rolling  | Monthly        | 2023-09 |[Codebook](https://api.viewsforecasting.org/predictors_fatalities002_0000_00/codebook) |
| predictors_fatalities002_2025_12     | fatalities        | 002                    | 1990-01     | 2025-12  | Monthly        | 2023-09 |[Codebook](https://api.viewsforecasting.org/predictors_fatalities002_0000_00/codebook) |
| escwa_features_2021_05_01 *          | ViEWS-ESCWA       | NA                     | 1990-01     | 2021-03  | Static         | 2021-05 | [Codebook](https://api.viewsforecasting.org/escwa_features_2021_05_01/codebook) |

\* The label for this dataset deviates from the standard naming convention since it was released before the current naming convention was put into practise. This dataset contains input data on a selection of the predictors that informed the ViEWS-ESCWA model. In this case, `2021_05` refers to the release date of the dataset. `01` is a default addition required by the API architecture – it holds no meaning for this specific dataset.
